trustProxy.impact: Client IP will be misidentified as reverse proxy IP (e.g. 127.0.0.1), breaking IP-based rate limiting, audit logs, and fraud detection

healthAndReadiness.impact: K8s/Docker health checks report healthy even when database is completely down or deadlocked

requestTimeout.impact: Unbounded request duration can lead to thread/connection starvation under hanging DB queries
